title: A Survey of Generative Categories and Techniques in Multimodal Generative Models
abstract: arXiv:2506.10016v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal generative models (MGMs) have rapidly expanded beyond text generation to encompass images, music, video, human motion, and 3D objects. This survey categorises six primary text-conditioned generative modalities and examines how four techniques, namely self-supervised learning, mixture of experts, reinforcement learning from human feedback, and chain-of-thought prompting, are adapted across them, distinguishing shared mechanisms from experimentally supported benefits. We organise evaluation around faithfulness, compositionality, and robustness, and interpret evidence within each study's protocol. translated_title: 多模态生成模型中的生成类别与技术综述
translated_abstract: 多模态生成模型（MGMs）已迅速超越文本生成范畴，扩展至图像、音乐、视频、人体动作和3D物体等领域。本综述对六种主要的以文本为条件的生成模态进行了分类，并考察了四种技术——即自监督学习、混合专家、基于人类反馈的强化学习以及思维链提示——如何在这些模态中被适配应用，从而区分共享机制与经实验验证的收益。我们围绕忠实性、组合性和鲁棒性来组织评估，并在每项研究的实验协议框架内解读证据。所审阅文献中报告的若干研究内比较支持四项发现：偏好增益未必能提升文本相关性，且奖励优化可能降低同一提示下的多样性；中间规划需要在最终输出中检验其是否得到实现；专家粒度的变化会改变机制及其存储方式（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 本综述系统分类了六类文本条件的多模态生成模态（图像、音乐、视频、人体动作、3D物体等），分析了自监督学习、混合专家、RLHF和思维链提示四种技术在各模态中的适配机制，并围绕忠实性、组合性和鲁棒性得出四项关键发现，包括偏好增益未必提升文本相关性、奖励优化可能降低输出多样性等。
en_tdlr: This survey categorizes six primary text-conditioned generative modalities in multimodal generative models, examines how four key techniques (self-supervised learning, mixture of experts, RLHF, and chain-of-thought prompting) are adapted across them, and derives four evidence-based findings around faithfulness, compositionality, and robustness.
